fields.webhookSkillIdHint: Internal: correlates workflow_trigger / POST /v1/channels/webhook/{skill_id} to this pool. NOT the public URL — external endpoints live in Channels → Webhook (slug → pool) and stay stable across skill versions.
fields.noCalendars: No calendars available. Create one in Configuration → Calendars.

exceptions.label: Pool Exceptions
exceptions.hint: Unique dates that override calendar rules only for this pool. Priority 1 — above holidays and weekly schedule.
exceptions.none: No exceptions configured for this pool.

queueCfg.label: Queue Treatment
queueCfg.hint: Skill-flow that attends the customer while waiting (attended queue). Empty = tenant default. Max wait closes the contact with max_wait_exceeded.

contextVisibility.label: Context Store Visibility
contextVisibility.hint: Namespaces visible to the operator in the Context tab. Separate with commas. Default: service, journey, session. PII namespaces (caller, account, history) appear masked when included.

typeCapacity.label: Type & Capacity
typeCapacity.agentKindHint: Governs capacity gates (AI vs. human) and the rule queue ⇒ human. Inferred = the platform decides (deploy slot ⇒ AI; otherwise human).
typeCapacity.queueNeedsHuman: Queue treatment requires a Human pool — set type to Human or clear the queue skill-flow.
typeCapacity.sessionReservationHint: Dedicated simultaneous-session slice carved from the contracted capacity (C). Empty = shares the common bucket. Σ reservations ≤ C.

dispatch.label: Queue dispatch mode
dispatch.hint: Push (default): the routing engine auto-allocates the contact. Pull: the contact waits in the queue and a logged-in agent claims it explicitly. Recommended for async (email, back-office, approval).

hooks.label: Lifecycle Hooks
hooks.hint: Specialists (pools) triggered at points of the human service. Each hook recruits an available instance from the chosen pool.
hooks.onContactEndHint: e.g. NPS / satisfaction survey (customer side). Fires once per contact.
hooks.onProcessEndHint: End of the workflow/process (webhook pool reaches complete). e.g. end-to-end journey survey, process QA. Only meaningful for webhook pools.

transfer.label: Transfer / Escalate
transfer.hint: Pools the human agent can transfer (escalate) the contact to. Shown in the Console Transfer combo.

mention.label: @mention Specialists
mention.hint: Specialist pools the human agent can invoke via @alias (assist / conference — does not transfer the contact).

llmAccounts.label: Preferred LLM Accounts
llmAccounts.hint: LLM accounts (Resources → LLM Accounts) this pool prefers, in preference order. The ai-gateway picks the least-loaded account among these; if none are available it falls back to the full account pool for the provider. Empty = no restriction.
llmAccounts.none: No preferred accounts — uses the full account pool.
llmAccounts.noAccounts: No LLM accounts registered. Configure in Resources → LLM Accounts.

routingFixed.label: Routing Weights — Fixed
routingFixed.hint: Importance of each competency skill in this pool. Set to 0 to ignore the skill in routing.
routingFixed.empty: No competency skills registered. Configure in Resources → Skills.

routingDynamic.label: Routing Weights — Dynamic
routingDynamic.hint: Influence of each real-time factor on queue ordering. 0 = ignore, 9 = maximum influence.

competencySkills.infoBanner: Competency skills are used in static routing — agents and pools declare a level (0-9) per skill. Stored in competency_skills in the Config API.
competencySkills.adminTokenWarning: ⚠ Set the admin token to edit
competencySkills.keyInvalid: Key: lowercase letters, digits and _ only

llmAccounts.infoBanner: LLM Accounts are referenced by id from Pools (Resources > Pools) to steer AI reasoning to a specific quota/account, with graceful fallback. The API key itself is never stored here — set it as an environment variable on ai-gateway.
llmAccounts.keyInvalid: Id: lowercase letters, digits and _ only

instances.readOnly: Read-only — instances are managed by the orchestrator-bridge

humanAgents.title: Human Agents
humanAgents.emptyLiveDesc: Agents appear here when they connect via Agent Assist UI
